FX-MINIMAX-001.says: The settings as they start: Maximum, radius 0, Color, Horizontal & Vertical: nothing changes.

FX-MINIMAX-002.says: Maximum, radius 1, Color: each colour channel becomes the largest of the 3 by 3 square's showing pixels; the covering is untouched, so the white box's black pixel turns white and the shapes keep their outline.

FX-MINIMAX-003.says: Minimum, radius 1, Color: the smallest of each channel; the white box's black pixel spreads to a 3 by 3 black square.

FX-MINIMAX-004.says: Maximum, radius 2, Alpha and Color: every shape grows two pixels each way in a square, the new pixels taking the largest showing colour (F's Max, w12b video 1 at 6:25).

FX-MINIMAX-005.says: Minimum, radius 1, Alpha: every shape's covering shrinks a pixel each side, the lone yellow pixel and the half-covered column go, and the block on the left loses its pixels along the layer's edges too, since past the edge counts as clear.

FX-MINIMAX-006.says: FX-MINIMAX-005 with Don't Shrink Edges on: the same, but the block keeps its pixels along the layer's left, top and bottom edges.

FX-MINIMAX-007.says: Minimum Then Maximum, radius 1, Alpha and Color: the lone yellow pixel and the half-covered column are taken away and the big shapes come back to their size.

FX-MINIMAX-008.says: Maximum Then Minimum, radius 1, Alpha and Color: the white box's black pixel is filled in and the shapes come back to their size.

FX-MINIMAX-009.says: Maximum, radius 2, Red, Just Horizontal: only red changes, the largest of five along the row.

FX-MINIMAX-010.says: Minimum, radius 1, Green, Just Vertical: only green changes, the smallest of three down the column.

FX-MINIMAX-011.says: Maximum, radius 1, Blue: only blue changes, so the blue column's blue spills into its showing neighbours.

FX-MINIMAX-012.says: Radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear, Maximum, Alpha and Color: the shapes grow a pixel a frame.

FX-MINIMAX-013.says: FX-MINIMAX-005 with the layer moved three pixels right: the same, moved; the layer's own edges still count.

FX-MINIMAX-014.says: Radius 1.5 is used as 2 (whole pixels, half up), radius 2.4 as 2: both frames equal FX-MINIMAX-004's.

FX-MINIMAX-015.says: Radius 501, above 500. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MINIMAX-016.says: Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MINIMAX-017.says: Operation "max": not one of the four words. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MINIMAX-018.says: Channel "rgb": not one of the six words. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MINIMAX-019.says: Direction "Horizontal": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MINIMAX-020.says: Don't Shrink Edges "yes": not on or off. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
